blk_pastries_explainer.text: Light food is good when you want more than a snack but not a big meal. A chicken sandwich is easy to eat with your hands. A cheese toastie is a hot sandwich with melted cheese. A garden salad is cooler and lighter. At places like Pret A Manger, people often grab a sandwich or a salad to eat for lunch. You can ask what is fresh today, or point to the item you want in the case.
